name: mcp.calendar.list
rests_on: agents-calendar CLI list VEVENTs; --from/--to are ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (a time without an offset is treated as UTC); returns a JSON array sorted by start time, so keep the range narrow; exit 0 = listed

from.description: Range start, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-29T16:00:00+01:00). A time without an offset is treated as UTC. Returns a JSON array sorted by start time; keep the range narrow.

to.description: Range end, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-29T16:00:00+01:00). A time without an offset is treated as UTC. Returns a JSON array sorted by start time; keep the range narrow.

calendar.description: Calendar collection name or URL to query (optional, defaults to all)
